label: development, not a verdict
reading_rules: A figure is a check on days that were already seen. Nothing here is a verdict, nothing is registered and no choice is made on it; (s3c) stays the candidate until she rules on the result.
A gain or loss is read from the 90% interval of mean d excluding zero; otherwise undecided. A point estimate alone is not read.
A pooled figure is never read without the regime, pressure-day-type and settlement-day splits beside it. The settlement days are few in the years the archive shows; the page states the counts.
The page says plainly in which years the indicators can be non-zero under the availability rule, and that in every other year the arm is (s3c) up to the refit of the fit.
The page cites no source for the idea beyond her ruling and compares with no outside figure.
The page ends with marked questions for Eleonora with numbered options and defaults that change no claim.
